label.zh-Hant: 一次週報執行（DigestRun Durable Object）

note.en: Run numbers are from the Dev run of 2026-10-19 22:47 UTC (`/health` `digest.lastRun`, read 2026-10-20). Prod has the digest off.
note.zh-Hant: 執行數字取自 Dev 2026-10-19 22:47 UTC 那次執行（`/health` 的 `digest.lastRun`，2026-10-20 讀取）。Prod 未開啟週報。

lead.en: Runs 40 minutes after the Dev publication; waits 15 minutes at a time, at most 4 times, while a publication is still running.
lead.zh-Hant: 在 Dev 發布後 40 分鐘執行；發布還在跑時每次延後 15 分鐘，最多 4 次。

lead.en: The digest pins one published release and never calls GitHub, Jira or the mailing list itself, so a run can be reproduced from its input.
lead.zh-Hant: 週報固定讀某一份已發布的 release，自己不呼叫 GitHub、Jira 或郵件串，所以每次執行都能依輸入重現。

lead.en: Threads with at least one human record in the 7 days ending at the release time; bot records are ignored.
lead.zh-Hant: 在 release 時間往前 7 天內，至少有一筆人類紀錄的 thread；機器人的紀錄不算。

lead.en: `@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash` answers one multiple-choice question per thread: 12 topics (releases, clients, streams, KRaft, security, …) or routine maintenance.
lead.zh-Hant: `@cf/cloudflare/clef-flash` 對每個 thread 回答一題選擇題：12 個主題（releases、clients、streams、KRaft、security…）或例行維護。

v.en: routine section ≥ 0.6; a topic below 0.35 becomes Uncategorized
v.zh-Hant: 例行維護需 ≥ 0.6；主題信心低於 0.35 歸入「未分類」

v.en: keyed by the classifier input and revision: an unchanged thread is not asked again
v.zh-Hant: 以分類輸入與版本為鍵：thread 沒變就不重問

lead.en: Score = Σ 0.5^(age in days / 3.5) / k over human records, where k is the author's nth record in the thread, so one person repeating themselves counts less. Each thread lands in exactly one place: a card, routine or Uncategorized.
lead.zh-Hant: 分數 = Σ 0.5^(天數 / 3.5) / k（加總人類紀錄，k 是該作者在此 thread 的第幾則），同一人重複發言的分量遞減。每個 thread 只會出現在一個地方：主題卡、例行維護或未分類。

lead.en: `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` writes up to 3 sentences per card, 1 per KIP row, then a headline and 3 highlights. It only sees the selected threads, and every sentence must cite them, e.g. `(KAFKA-PR-23829, closed)`.
lead.zh-Hant: `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` 每張卡最多寫 3 句、每個 KIP 列 1 句，再寫一個標題與 3 條重點。模型只看得到被選中的 thread，每句都必須引用它們，例如 `(KAFKA-PR-23829, closed)`。

lead.en: Deterministic checks drop a sentence instead of publishing it: wrong length, no citation, a citation outside the inputs, a status word the source does not support ("merged" for an open PR, "verified" without a [RESULT] thread), a stance word ("objected", "rejected"), or a second proposal in one line. A card left empty shows "AI summary unavailable".
lead.zh-Hant: 用確定性的規則擋句子，不合格就不發布：長度不對、沒有引用、引用了輸入以外的東西、狀態詞與來源不符（PR 還 open 卻寫 merged、沒有 [RESULT] 卻寫 verified）、立場詞（objected、rejected）、一行裡出現第二個提案。整張卡都被擋下時顯示「AI summary unavailable」。

v.zh-Hant: 1 個無法解析的模型輸出、1 個 `status:verified`、1 個 `status:fixed`

v.en: a status-tense rule ("is added" for an unfinished item) in [PR #101](https://github.com/unknowntpo/oss-knowledge-base/pull/101)
v.zh-Hant: 時態規則（項目未完成卻寫 is added）在 [PR #101](https://github.com/unknowntpo/oss-knowledge-base/pull/101)

lead.en: `@cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8` translates the validated English in batches of 60. Identifiers, citations and links are swapped for placeholders first; if one is lost, the item stays in English and is labelled "Not translated".
lead.zh-Hant: `@cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8` 以每批 60 句翻譯通過驗證的英文。編號、引用與連結先換成佔位符；若佔位符遺失，該項保留英文並標示「Not translated」。

v.en: a status guard and a Kafka glossary for the translation in [PR #101](https://github.com/unknowntpo/oss-knowledge-base/pull/101)
v.zh-Hant: 翻譯的狀態詞檢查與 Kafka 術語表在 [PR #101](https://github.com/unknowntpo/oss-knowledge-base/pull/101)

lead.en: `en.json`, then `zh-Hant.<hash>.json`, then the pointer, so the site never shows a translation without its source.
lead.zh-Hant: 先寫 `en.json`，再寫 `zh-Hant.<hash>.json`，最後才更新指標，網站不會出現沒有原文的翻譯。

lead.en: Every model call is charged to a daily ledger before it is made; over 5,000 estimated neurons a UTC day the run stops. A second limit sits in AI Gateway: 60 requests an hour and $2 a month.
lead.zh-Hant: 每次呼叫模型之前先記帳；同一 UTC 日超過 5,000 估計 neurons 就停止。第二道限制在 AI Gateway：每小時 60 次、每月 2 美元。

lead.en: What the quality gate reviews: cards, KIP block, headline and highlights, each sentence with its citations.
lead.zh-Hant: 品質門檻審的就是這份：卡片、KIP 區塊、標題與重點，每句附引用。

lead.en: Item-for-item translation of the English digest.
lead.zh-Hant: 英文週報逐項對應的翻譯。

lead.en: Top to bottom: headline, window and stats, up to 3 highlights, KIP proposals by stage (discuss, vote, implementing), topic cards, then Uncategorized and Routine collapsed.
lead.zh-Hant: 由上到下：標題、時間範圍與統計、最多 3 條重點、依階段排列的 KIP 提案（討論、投票、實作中）、主題卡片，最後是收合的未分類與例行維護。

lead.en: A human labels one real week sentence by sentence; `bun run digest -- eval` counts the errors. Prod is enabled only when the thresholds are met.
lead.zh-Hant: 人工逐句標註一個真實的週報，`bun run digest -- eval` 計算錯誤數；達到門檻才開 Prod。
